# Axtra Labs
> AI-augmented software engineering from Vietnam. Gen AI, data, robotics, and DevOps teams that ship production systems.

- Site: https://axtralabs.com
- Contact: contact@axtralabs.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/axtralabs/
- Full text for AI agents: https://axtralabs.com/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://axtralabs.com/sitemap.xml

## Services
- [AI Services](https://axtralabs.com/ai-services): Gen AI apps, agents, RAG pipelines, LLM fine-tuning
- [Data & BI](https://axtralabs.com/data-bi): Pipelines, warehouses, dashboards, decision intelligence
- [Embedded Software](https://axtralabs.com/embedded-software): Firmware, RTOS, embedded Linux, connected devices
- [AI for Robotics](https://axtralabs.com/ai-robotics): Perception, navigation, edge inference
- [DevOps](https://axtralabs.com/devops): CI/CD, Kubernetes, MLOps
- [AI-Software Development](https://axtralabs.com/ai-software-development): Full-stack AI-native product teams
